query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  data,
  (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) as total,
  updatedAt
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data = '2026-05-28'
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
